_doc: Guardrail self-protection. Sessions (including bypass-mode sessions) may read these paths but never modify, move, delete, chmod or git-restore them; policy_guard.py blocks it through Edit/Write/MultiEdit/NotebookEdit and Bash, and settings.json denies the Edit/Write forms. Only the founder changes them: with an editor outside the session, or in a maintenance session started with `claude --setting-sources user` (loads no project settings, so it runs without these guards). repo_globs are relative to the project root (** = any depth); home_paths are relative to $HOME. trunk_refs: a checkout, pull, merge or rebase may change protected files only when the target is one of these refs AND it already contains .claude/settings.json (founder-merged control plane).
